paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ge addition on microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of quinary Nb-16Si-22Ti-2Al-2Cr alloy
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials

evidence.quote: The niobium ‑ silicon (Nb – Si)-based alloys have attracted significant research attention as the potential candidate for the hot-end components of next-generation aero engine due to their excellent properties.

The effects of different Ge contents on microstructure, room-temperature fracture toughness and high-temperature compression strength of Nb-16Si-22Ti-2Al-2Cr alloy are systematically investigated.

The five nominal compositions of Nb-16Si-22Ti-2Al-2Cr- x Ge ( x = 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 at.%, respectively) button ingots were prepared in a vac - uum non-consumable arc furnace with a tungsten electrode under an argon atmosphere in a water-cooled copper crucible. evidence.quote: The eutectic structures of Nbss/ β -Nb 5 Si 3 are chaotic and irregular, in which the β -Nb 5 Si 3 distributes in continuous Nbss.
